builds.name: Reference: Contact fighter
builds.goal: Reference for Shyvana: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A transforming melee fighter who earns defenses through takedowns and uses empowered dragon spells to extend close combat. Use the current reworked dragon/human abilities and finite Fury. Q attacks lower Q cooldown and have current HP/AD effects; do not import an old E-only AP build without measuring it. Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage.
builds.summary: Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage.
testPlan: Kit question for Shyvana: Use the current reworked dragon/human abilities and finite Fury. Q attacks lower Q cooldown and have current HP/AD effects; do not import an old E-only AP build without measuring it.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then Sundered Sky) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: Fury. Do not treat mana regeneration as Fury recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.
